description: Converting a tuple fails when an element has no conversion to its type in the target
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec makes this conversion an error, because a tuple converts to another tuple type only when each element converts, and there is no conversion from bool to number (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions, spec.md#primitive-type-conversions).
